data.description: gives the activator a +2 insight bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks against the coin's current possessor. In addition, the possessor takes a -1 penalty on saving throws against spells with the emotion, fear, or scrying descriptors cast by the coin's activator.
